messages:
elaine: FYI — mariner-3B (open model) ready for catalog intake but we have a few gating items: license confirmation, perf profile (latency/throughput), quantization compatibility test, and infra perf job. Can owners self-assign? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/412
samir: I can take license/compat checks. @legal-bot can you confirm the license on the upstream repo? :eyes:
legal-bot: Repository lists "MIT" in LICENSE file. No additional restrictions flagged. Recommend SPDX: MIT.
jordan: Perf baseline: I ran a quick perf on a single V100 (seq=512) — p50 ~ 78ms, p95 ~ 210ms. But KV cache eviction test fails intermittently.
jordan: snippet:
```
./bench --model mariner-3b --seq 512 --batch 1 --kv-cache-test
```
morgan: @devinfra can you repro KV cache flakiness on our multi-GPU config? Might be scheduler interaction.
devinfra: I'll spin up a 4xA100 job and run the bench by EOD. Need the checkpoint path.
samir: checkpoint: s3://redwood-models/mariner-3b/v1/checkpoint.pt
samir: also legal: is redistribution allowed? we need to know for hosted vs private.
legal-bot: MIT allows redistribution. For hosted inference, normal TOS applies. No export control flags.
troy-bot: CI failure on model-ops tests: https://ci.redwood/1234 — failing at quantize step, log: "unsupported op aten::native_layer_norm"
elaine: OK that's perf infra + runtime. @eng-runtime please prioritize quantization plugin for native_layer_norm or fallback path.
jordan: re: perf profile — I'll add a perf yaml to the PR with p50/p95 and token/s numbers. Expect to push by tomorrow morning.
morgan: owners list we currently have: samir (legal/compat), jordan (perf), devinfra (infra), eng-runtime (quant). I'll update the intake doc and assign in the catalogue table. :white_check_mark:
elaine: Great. Can we have a final decision on inclusion by EOD tomorrow? If any blocking license/runtime gaps remain we'll mark as "staged" for next wave.
samir: ack, I'll follow up with legal if anything else pops.
elaine: thanks all — leaving this thread open for quick async updates. :slightly_smiling_face:
